import sys,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'test/wsdl-interop')
from test_element_substitution import membership_models,source
from test_attribute_values import NS,XSD
from independent import SchemaJob,run
from lxml import etree
jobs=[]; cases=[]; expected={}; lxml_results={}
for index,(name,body,head,members,value) in enumerate(membership_models()):
    schema=source(body+'<xs:element name="Container"><xs:complexType><xs:sequence>'+f'<xs:element ref="t:{head}"/></xs:sequence></xs:complexType></xs:element>')
    tree=etree.fromstring(schema.encode()); compiler=etree.XMLSchema(tree)
    candidates=sorted({n.get('name') for n in tree.findall(f'{{{XSD}}}element')}-{'Container','Submit','Reply'})
    documents=[]
    for candidate in candidates:
        key=name+'/'+candidate; xml=f'<t:Container xmlns:t="{NS}"><t:{candidate}>{value}</t:{candidate}></t:Container>'
        documents.append({'name':key,'xml':xml,'valid':candidate in members})
        expected[key]=candidate in members; lxml_results[key]=compiler.validate(etree.fromstring(xml.encode()))
    cases.append({'name':name,'schema':schema,'uri':NS,'head':head,'members':sorted(f'{{{NS}}}{m}' for m in members),'documents':documents})
    jobs.append(SchemaJob(name,f'http://example.invalid/groups/{index}.xsd',schema.encode(),{d['name']:d['xml'].encode() for d in documents}))
oracle=run(jobs);Path('/tmp/wsdl-p5-06-group-oracles-cases.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases))
process=subprocess.run(['qore','-b','--enable-debug','test/wsdl-interop/element-substitution-groups.qr','/tmp/wsdl-p5-06-group-oracles-cases.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
print('PROCESS',process.returncode,process.stderr)
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in process.stdout.splitlines()]
native={r['document']:not r['error'] for r in rows if 'document' in r}
report={'versions':{'lxml':etree.LXML_VERSION,'libxml':etree.LIBXML_VERSION,**oracle['versions']},'rows':[]}
for key,valid in expected.items():
    row={'name':key,'expected':valid,'lxml':lxml_results[key],'xerces':oracle['documents'][key]['ok'],'native':native.get(key)}
    report['rows'].append(row)
    if any(row[k]!=valid for k in ('lxml','xerces','native')):print(row)
print('ERRORS',sorted({r['error'] for r in rows if 'error' in r}))
Path('/tmp/wsdl-p5-06-group-oracles.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
